label: New materials
name: OCEANPOWER New Material Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Civil engineering materials, advanced coatings, new polymers and digital colour technology for sustainable construction.

sections.title: Company overview
paragraphs: OCEANPOWER New Material Technology Co., Ltd. has a registered capital of 3,333 million Chinese yuan and two divisions: Civil Engineering Materials and Coating New Materials. Its production centres are located in Pudong, Shanghai (50,000 square metres) and Heyuan, Guangdong (100,000 square metres). The company has 56 offices and branches across China's main provinces and selected regions around the world.

sections.title: Technology and innovation
paragraphs: Through national scientific and technological support projects and its standardisation strategy, OCEANPOWER develops its capabilities in original and strategic innovation. Its work includes breakthroughs in low-carbon materials, land and material conservation, energy saving and water saving. Its products and services have received certifications from relevant authorities and have been used in major projects in China.

With technology and innovation at the core of its business philosophy, the company provides low-carbon engineering materials, new polymer materials, and personalised products and services in digital colour technology. These include integrated coatings and colour solutions designed to create value together with customers.
By bringing together its resources and strengths, OCEANPOWER seeks further advances in products and services and opportunities to participate in domestic and international capital markets.

sections.title: Purpose and responsibility
paragraphs: Our pursuit is to provide sustainable solutions. Our ambition is to embrace challenges, pursue self-improvement, serve the community and create the future.
Our responsibility is to create wealth for society, value for customers, profits for shareholders and opportunities for employees.

OCEANPOWER works with new and existing customers to contribute to scientific development and economic restructuring, with the ambition of becoming a leader in the development of new materials in China.

label: Food
name: Shenzhen OCEANPOWER Food Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Soft ice cream machines, ice cream powder and food technology, combining equipment manufacturing with research and service.

sections.title: Company overview
paragraphs: Founded in 1996, Shenzhen OCEANPOWER Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Shenzhen OCEANPOWER Industry Co., Ltd. Its main products are soft ice cream machines, ice cream powder and other healthy foods.
OCEANPOWER has built its reputation on reliable soft ice cream machines and manufacturing management, serving markets around the world.

sections.title: Food safety and manufacturing
paragraphs: Since 1996, the company has used advanced manufacturing technologies to meet safety, health and environmental requirements. Materials used in its food machinery include SUS304 stainless steel, ABS and POM plastic consumable parts, and silicone rubber packing and gaskets.

The company profile describes OCEANPOWER as China's largest professional manufacturer of soft ice cream machines and ice cream powder. It lists CE, CB, NSF, LET, UL, RoHS, GOST and GS certifications, together with HACCP practices, ISO14001 environmental certification and SGS ISO9001 quality certification for the company and its production line.

sections.title: Research and international reach
paragraphs: Following decades of development, more than 70 branch offices have been established in China and abroad. The company invests in research and development and cooperates with universities and research institutions. It has obtained more than 20 national patents and was authorised by the Standardization Administration of China to set national standards for soft ice cream machines and powder in 2005.

Its products serve Southeast Asia, the Middle East, South America, Europe, Oceania and Africa. Guided by Quality, Service and Reputation, OCEANPOWER continues to meet challenges and develop its business for the future.

label: Environment
name: Shenzhen OCEANPOWER Environmental Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: UV disinfection, membrane technology and water reuse solutions for municipal drinking water and wastewater treatment.

sections.title: Water safety and engineering
paragraphs: Shenzhen OCEANPOWER Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. is committed to water safety. It designs, manufactures and sells UV disinfection and sewage reuse systems for municipal wastewater and drinking water treatment, with services covering engineering design, project contracting and technical support.
Through continuous innovation, the company has built a professional team with product development capabilities, engineering experience and after-sales service.

sections.title: Standards and cooperation
paragraphs: OCEANPOWER developed the national standard GB/T19837—2005, Ultraviolet (UV) disinfection equipment for municipal water and wastewater treatment. Its company profile identifies it as the standing secretariat department of National Technical Committee 299 on Ultraviolet Disinfection of the Standardization Administration of China, a major member of the national environmental products technical committee and a council member of the International Ultraviolet Association (IUVA).

The company offers cooperation from design consulting to project financing and undertakes projects supported by organisations including the World Bank, Asian Development Bank and United Nations Industrial Development Organization. It also researches and promotes technologies for municipal water treatment, particularly water and wastewater disinfection.

sections.title: UV disinfection and membrane technology
paragraphs: Guided by Safety Comes First, OCEANPOWER develops safe, advanced and cost-effective UV treatment solutions. It maintains strategic cooperation with leading membrane technology suppliers to research wastewater treatment, advanced treatment, water reuse and zero liquid discharge systems and equipment.

The company profile lists ISO9001 quality certification and ISO 14000 environmental management certification, as well as product authentications from NSF, NWRI, USEPA and CE. It describes cooperation with universities, research institutes and design institutes on water quality and safety solutions, and a post-doctoral research centre approved by the Ministry of Personnel. It also reports recognition as a leading national patent enterprise for three consecutive years.

sections.title: Projects and support
paragraphs: More than 60 branch offices and subsidiaries in China and abroad provide technical support and after-sales service.

The supplied company profile reports that more than 400 large and medium-sized wastewater treatment plants use OCEANPOWER technology and products, with more than 60% of China's wastewater disinfection market. It highlights Shanghai Bailonggang WWTP, with a treatment capacity of 2.6 million cubic metres per day, as the world's largest UV disinfection system at the time of the profile.
OCEANPOWER aims to become a leader in the global UV disinfection industry and contribute to environmental protection.

label: Information
name: Shenzhen OCEANPOWER Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Software development, system integration, digital colour tools and industry information platforms for construction and coatings.

sections.title: Company overview
paragraphs: Shenzhen OCEANPOWER Information Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech company directly under Oceanpower Group. It specialises in software development, system integration and information technology consulting for construction engineering and chemical coatings.

sections.title: Digital colour and industry software
paragraphs: With a strong technology research and development team, the company develops management software and e-commerce application solutions for chemical businesses. Its building colour solutions include the China Building Color Digital Color Card, Oceanpower Building Color Creative Design Software and professional colour management software, addressing gaps in China's industry.

Drawing on its technical capabilities and industry experience, the company developed an emulsion, pigments and fillers database query system. It provides manufacturer information and product data to support reliable technical product selection.

sections.title: Industry platforms and partnerships
paragraphs: The company develops and operates China Coating Online, China Asphalt Web and China Recycled Asphalt, providing service platforms for the coatings and asphalt industries.

As an early industry portal, China Coating Online maintains relationships with government departments and organisations including China's Ministry of Chemical Industry, the Science and Technology Division of the Ministry of Construction, and the Architectural Coatings Engineering Research Center of the Ministry of Construction.

It also builds long-term partnerships with the China Coating Industry Association, Changzhou Coating Chemical Institute, Lanzhou Chemical Institute, universities, colleges and research institutions to share resources and pursue development together.
